subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agentDir` become a second bootstrap authority that silently overrides same-named files in the agent workspace?
rationale: Current source and documentation make the workspace the bootstrap authority, while this PR changes which local instructions can control agent behavior and potentially replace workspace safety rules during upgrades.

options.title: Keep Workspace Canonical
options.body: Preserve the documented workspace authority and use a clear warning when bootstrap-named files are found in `agentDir`.

options.title: Approve Explicit Overlay
options.body: Allow explicitly configured `agentDir` files to override workspace files after adding caller coverage, documentation, diagnostics, upgrade proof, and live behavior evidence.

options.title: Require Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Introduce an explicit policy surface for overlay semantics only if maintainers conclude the additional configuration is justified despite the repository's high config-surface bar.

recommendation.title: Keep Workspace Canonical
recommendation.body: Preserve the documented workspace authority and use a clear warning when bootstrap-named files are found in `agentDir`.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest sampled history across the bootstrap resolver and the documented workspace/bootstrap ownership contract.
